contributor.description: Person, team, or organisation that contributed to the hunt (Equip > Contributors).

data-source.description: Data source examined during the hunt (Equip > Data Sources Examined).

methodology.description: Hunt methodology, per the PEAK framework. Mirror on the event as a hunt:methodology tag.

period-end.description: End of the data window examined by the hunt.

period-start.description: Start of the data window examined by the hunt.

purpose.description: Why the hunt is being conducted: the trigger, driving intelligence, or business question (Purpose section).

status.description: Lifecycle state of the hunt. Mirror on the event as a workflow:state tag.

tool.description: Tooling or platform used to execute the hunt (Equip > Tools Utilized).

description: Metadata describing the purpose, methodology, and resourcing of a threat hunt. One instance per MISP event; corresponds to the Purpose and Equip sections of the hunt report.
name: threat-hunt-context
